name: Exp_ColorZerolagJJRSX
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagJJRSX custom indicator, a zero-lag composite JJRSX oscillator. It opens buy positions when the fast oscillator crosses above the slow one and sell positions when the fast crosses below the slow one, with configurable position closing on reverse signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorZerolagJJRSX进行交易，该指标是一个零滞后复合JJRSX振荡器。当快速振荡线向上穿越慢速线时开多仓，向下穿越时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用ColorZerolagJJRSX零滞后复合振荡器的双线交叉进行动量交易。入场条件为：当Osc1（主线）从下方穿越Osc2（信号线）时产生买入信号，当Osc1从上方穿越Osc2时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数平仓，以及反向交叉信号触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数和按资金比例两种模式（由MMMode决定）。振荡器由5个不同周期（8,21,34,55,89）的JJRSX加权组合而成，各因子分别为0.05,0.10,0.16,0.26,0.43，旨在消除滞后性。策略支持独立的买卖开仓和平仓开关，允许灵活控制交易方向。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the ColorZerolagJJRSX zero-lag composite oscillator's dual-line crossover for momentum trading. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Osc1 (main line) crosses above Osc2 (signal line), and a sell signal when Osc1 crosses below Osc2. Exit conditions include fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points, plus reverse crossover signal-triggered position closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot and margin-proportional modes (determined by MMMode). The oscillator is a weighted composite of 5 JJRSX indicators with different periods (8,21,34,55,89) and factors (0.05,0.10,0.16,0.26,0.43), designed to eliminate lag. The strategy supports independent buy/sell open and close switches, allowing flexible control over trading direction.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制仓位大小
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling position size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位模式：固定手数或按资金比例
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (fixed lot or margin ratio)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号计算使用的K线索引

pros: 零滞后复合振荡器设计减少了传统指标的延迟问题
独立的买卖开仓和平仓控制开关提供了灵活的交易方向管理
5层加权JJRSX组合使用斐波那契周期（8,21,34,55,89）增强了多时间尺度信号稳定性
设有止损和止盈参数，具备基本风险控制
使用IsNewBar机制避免同一K线内重复交易
pros_en: Zero-lag composite oscillator design reduces the lag issue of traditional indicators
Independent buy/sell open and close switches provide flexible trading direction management
5-layer weighted JJRSX composition using Fibonacci periods (8,21,34,55,89) enhances multi-timescale signal stability
StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters provide basic risk control
IsNewBar mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
cons: 依赖自定义指标ColorZerolagJJRSX，无法独立运行，指标缺失时EA将初始化失败
没有点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生虚假信号
止损和止盈使用固定点数而非动态调整，未考虑市场波动率变化
缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑，一次性全进全出
没有显式的持仓数量检查，可能重复开仓
cons_en: Depends on custom indicator ColorZerolagJJRSX and cannot run independently; EA fails initialization if indicator is missing
No spread filter mechanism, may generate false signals in high-spread environments
StopLoss and TakeProfit use fixed points rather than dynamic adjustment, ignoring market volatility changes
Lacks scaling in/out logic, all-in all-out approach only
No explicit position count check, may open duplicate positions
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动率自适应止损止盈机制（如ATR止损），提高在不同市场条件下的适应性
增加持仓数量检查和最大持仓限制，防止重复开仓和过度风险敞口
增加交易时间过滤和重要新闻事件回避机制，避免非理性市场波动造成的损失
improvements_en: Add spread filter and volatility-adaptive StopLoss/TakeProfit (e.g., ATR-based stops) to improve adaptability across different market conditions
Add position count check and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate opening and excessive risk exposure
Add trading session filter and major news event avoidance to prevent losses from irrational market volatility

risk_points: 没有显式持仓数量检查，可能在同一方向上重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
固定点数止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，在低波动时止损过宽而在高波动时止盈过窄
依赖外部自定义指标，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行且不会给出清晰错误提示
risk_points_en: No explicit position count check, may open duplicate positions in the same direction leading to excessive risk exposure
Fixed point StopLoss/TakeProfit does not account for market volatility, stop too wide in low volatility and take-profit too narrow in high volatility
Depends on external custom indicator; EA fails silently without clear error message when indicator file is missing
